title: Lazy Day Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars
description: A simple and delicious chocolate chip cookie bar recipe that requires minimal effort.

ingredients.item: One box of yellow cake mix
One stick of salted butter, melted
A 12-ounce bag of chocolate chips (or three combined bags if needed)

steps: Add the yellow cake mix to a mixing bowl.
Pour in the melted salted butter.
Mix all ingredients until beautifully combined.
Add the chocolate chips and mix until thoroughly combined.
Pour the mixture into a greased 9x13 baking dish and spread evenly.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 20 to 25 minutes, until edges are toasty.
Let cool before cutting and serving.
Optional: Drizzle with caramel or chocolate, or serve with a scoop of ice cream.
